observations: The engine-oil row explicitly assigns 3.3 liters to K7M and 4.9 liters to K4M; these are not interchangeable capacities.
The asterisk after the 5000–7000 km interval points to the site's own shorter-interval recommendation for described operating conditions.
The site attributes a 15000 km interval to Renault, but no primary Renault maintenance document was verified here.
The page tells readers to check the vehicle operating instructions before applying its lubricant information.

requiredHandling.capacitySelection: Use only the explicitly named installed-engine branch; preserve unknown filter/service-volume context.
requiredHandling.replacementInterval: Retain 5000–7000 km only as an attributed secondary-source recommendation, not an OEM verified service interval.
requiredHandling.manufacturerInterval: Do not populate a verified Renault interval from this secondary attribution alone.
requiredHandling.specification: Keep source-listed specifications separate from the interval and recommendation text.
